A satellite is launched into a circular orbit at altitude above a planet's surface. What happens to the gravitational field strength and potential energy of the satellite as it ascends to this orbit?

Gravitational Field StrengthGravitational Potential Energy
A.IncreasesBecomes more negative
B.IncreasesBecomes less negative
C.DecreasesBecomes less negative
D.DecreasesBecomes more negative
